prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
(none yet)

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
(not available)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 79.1%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 75.2%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 89.2%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 78.5%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 25.4%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Spotlight Personality Traits Pet Selector Layout: Redesign the pet creation step into a focused spotlight card layout highlighting pet behavior archetypes and audio voice profiles. (why: Adoption has the lowest conversion rate in the onboarding funnel at 60.9%, and users report custom pet results looking wrong.)
1: [adoption, new_screen] Pet Naming & Birth Certificate Screen: Insert a dedicated pet naming and birth certificate confirmation screen right before final adoption finalizing. (why: Adoption step drops off significantly at 60.9%; adding an emotional ownership milestone strengthens commitment to finish.)
2: [adoption, new_flow] Guided Multi-Angle Photo Checklist Sub-Flow: Replace single photo drop with a guided 3-stage photo checklist sub-flow for lighting, face angle, and background contrast. (why: Support receives multiple tickets about custom pet generation failing or rendering improperly.)
3: [sign_in, reorder] Defer Sign-In to Final Pre-Spawn Step: Reorder the sign-in step to occur at the end of adoption right before the desktop pet rendering wait screen. (why: Sign-in upfront creates early friction (mean 567s) before users have created or bonded with their pet.)
4: [sign_in, hint] Cloud Sync & Reset Prevention Guarantee Hint: Add a highlighted hint explaining how account creation guarantees your pet state will never be lost or reset on restart. (why: Support received 8 emails specifically regarding pets missing or resetting after signing in again.)
5: [finish, copy] Desktop Screen Edge & Dock Positioning Guide: Update the home_intro screen headline and body copy to explain where the pet lives on the desktop screen edge. (why: 3 support tickets noted pet not showing on desktop or users not knowing how to reveal/open it.)
6: [choose_path, hint] Interactive Path Selector Quiz Hint Banner: Add an interactive 5-second recommendation quiz hint component on the story screen to guide undecided users. (why: The mean time spent on choose_path is 514s, showing users take long decisions before selecting a path.)
